Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request, the loyalty service shall return whether the voucher can be applied.
WHEN a member returns a purchase within the return window, the loyalty service shall reverse the points of that purchase.
Rationale: Returns must not leave points behind.

Text: The loyalty service shall deliver the daily points-liability extract to the data warehouse by TBD local time.
